query: WITH arrivals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS arrival_count FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala WHERE entry_timestamp BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-09-30' AND person_type != 'مواطن'), departures AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS departure_count FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala WHERE exit_timestamp BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-09-30' AND person_type != 'مواطن') SELECT arrivals.arrival_count, departures.departure_count FROM arrivals, departures LIMIT 1200
raw_question: كم عدد المغادرين والقادمين الأجانب في الربع الثالث من عام 2023؟
